literal_meaning: খচখচ শব্দ বা চটুলতা (snappish or irritable sound/behavior)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার মতো খচো মানুষ আগে দেখিনি।
example_sentences_in_english: I've never seen a grumpy person like you before.
He is a very irritable person by nature.
note: The parenthetical '(অশালীন)' in input may be a misinterpretation; idiom primarily denotes grumpiness, not indecency.
